acceptance_criteria.description: A registered BackendFactory executes only digest-bound images through an absolute launcher path
Runtime identity network GPU usage artifact export cancellation and teardown receipts are persisted
Standalone verification closes the Apptainer boundary and rejects identity or artifact drift
Focused failure resume timeout and teardown tests pass

objective: Add a digest-bound Apptainer BackendFactory, runtime receipts, cancellation and teardown semantics, and standalone verification before any Apptainer run can become claim-candidate.
title: Implement an evidence-bound Apptainer backend adapter
